::: {.about-lede}
We're Peter and Marta, often known together as **PeteMart**. This is our shared home on the web for things we make, learn, and want to remember.
:::

## Why make a family website?

Because the nicest parts of the internet still feel handmade.

We wanted something more lasting than a social feed and less formal than a portfolio: a place where a technical deep dive can sit beside a trip report, a favorite recipe, or a tiny project that made us smile.

::: {.about-aside}
> Think of it as a kitchen table with unusually good support for equations and source code.
:::

## What you'll find here
